info.title: GovCon Sources Sought, RFI & Set-Aside Shaping Responder API
info.description: Transforms raw SAM.gov or SLED Sources Sought notices, Requests for Information (RFIs), and vendor capability profiles into a FAR Part 10 / 19.502-2 Rule-of-Two Set-Aside Shaping Assessment (SDVOSB, 8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, Total SB), requirement-by-requirement Capability Alignment Matrix, Acquisition Shaping Recommendations (NAICS, contract vehicles, evaluation factors, restrictive requirement removals), and a paste-ready Sources Sought / RFI Capability Statement.

post.summary: Generate Sources Sought, RFI Capability Matrix & Rule-of-Two Set-Aside Shaping Package
post.operationId: Generate Sources Sought, RFI Capability Matrix & Rule-of-Two Set-Aside Shaping Package

sources_sought_notice_text.description: Raw SAM.gov or SLED Sources Sought notice, Request for Information (RFI), draft SOW/PWS scope, and market research questions.
sources_sought_notice_text.example: SOURCES SOUGHT / RFI W15P7T-26-R-0412 (U.S. Army CECOM Enterprise Zero-Trust Cloud & DevSecOps Modernization): Market research under FAR Part 10 to determine Small Business (SDVOSB / 8(a) / HUBZone) capability under NAICS 541512 ($34.0M size standard). Scope: (1) Migrate 18 legacy C5ISR applications to AWS GovCloud IL5 with continuous ATO (cATO); (2) Operate 24x7 DevSecOps CI/CD pipelines and automated STIG compliance; (3) Provide cleared TS/SCI Cloud & Cyber engineering personnel at Aberdeen Proving Ground, MD.

company_capabilities_and_vehicles.description: Vendor core competencies, socio-economic certifications (8(a), SDVOSB, HUBZone, WOSB, Small Business), NAICS codes, contract vehicles (GSA MAS, OASIS+, 8(a) STARS III, CIO-SP3, SEWP), clearances, and past performance.
company_capabilities_and_vehicles.example: Vanguard Cyber Defense LLC (UEI: K8M4N9P2Q7R1 | CAGE: 8X9A2) — SBA Verified SDVOSB & 8(a) Certified Small Business under NAICS 541512, 541519, 541511. Contract Vehicles: GSA MAS SIN 54151S / 54151HACS / 518210C, 8(a) STARS III, Army ITES-3S. Facility Clearance: Top Secret FCL; 42 TS/SCI cleared cloud & cyber engineers. Past Performance: (1) USAF Kessel Run IL5 DevSecOps & cATO ($14.2M Prime, 2024-2026); (2) DISA Enterprise Zero-Trust ICAM & AWS GovCloud Migration ($9.8M Prime, 2023-2026).

target_set_aside_goal.description: Desired FAR Part 19 socio-economic set-aside outcome to advocate for in the Contracting Officer market research package.

desired_contract_vehicle_and_naics.description: Optional preferred GWAC/IDIQ vehicle (e.g., GSA MAS 54151HACS, 8(a) STARS III, OASIS+ SB) and target NAICS code to shape the acquisition toward.
